content: Kurin yiri kuu Godbed nub awoya yaa profesidan yaambed aron yemoon kuu kiwaan yemoonbed daandemboroon.

Kumban kibik aron yeenbon kee, ye Dana Mingki yaambed nub yaa daandoon. Kwane, ye kuu Godbed kumkam korem yaa kangkoman keruni ye dowad kine kowoon. Kwanekore, ye yaambed Godbed kumkam korem kuu ongmenaboon.

Mingki kuu God ye nambiri kuu dianmo keroon. Ye kuu ye Ambe ye inamen meeni korem areb ibmo doboroon. Ye weng aromkonoyiib kumbed kumkam korem angkeen. Kwane, ambarakmi aari ye kiwaan kuu ambangke dowan kerekore, Ewen ari daane Aningko Arimbed Ye God ye dingki wiwi angkambed dibeen.
Kowe, Godbed kine kowoon yaningko Mingkimbed awinoon kuu engyu yi aningko burudandoon arimbed areb, Mingki kuu arimbed, engyu arebban.
Kedi, engyu kane yaa Godbed ma kwane yedmoon,

content.text: “Eb kuu ne Dana,
kibikee ne kuu eb Ambe keraan.” andoon? Dowan!

content: O, engyu kane yaa Godbed ma kwane yedmoon,

content.text: “Ne kuu ye Ambe keraniine,
ye kuu ne Dana keraneen.” andoon? Dowan!

content: Kwane angkon Godbed ye wonobdana okad yiri nenkowe yedmoon,

content.text: “Engyu korem kuu ye yaa bumangke yaningko kankoonime.” andoon.

content: Engyu yi dowad daande yedmoon kuu,

content.text: “Ye engyu ongmendaane nuub areb kerimaib,
ye demedan kee ongmendaane amot yumbu areb kerimaib.” andoon.

content: Kumban ye Dana Mingki ye dowad yedmoon kuu,

content.text: “O God, eb oonimbon kuu aron korem korem kwane angkimberembaranuun,
eb ambibkin aom kuu yorokmo ye aromkonombed oonaneeb.
Yorokmo dobiri yaa dowakenmo kerewen, kumban inamen arewa yaa arud wandemberewen.
Kwanikob, God, eb Godbed eb korok ari kubi yeman olif ambod ye oiyo bune kinoon kumbed,
eb nendene eb angkodmia burudande ari nenkowoon.” andoon.
“O Yariman, yimin andowoon yiri okad ye ambokab ongmeneb,
ambid kuu eb dingkimbed ambangkewen.
Yi kuu dowan keraniib kumban eb kuu kwane doberembaraneeb.
Kwane, yi kuu ebkad areb korob kere biringke dowan keraniib.
Yi kuu yuruk ebkad doboob areb bedmaneeb.
Yi kuu ebkad biande ebkad yeeb ben deebendemoon areb keraniib.
Kumban eb kuu doreebmo kwane dobaraneeb,
kwane eb weeb kuu yimin wandaunban.” andoon.

content: Engyu kane yaa Godbed ma kwane yedmoon,

content.text: “Ne dingki wiwi angka diberebko,
kwane wene nembed eb bondan kuu beni
eb yondad dabderem yiri kiriba.” andoon? Dowan, Mingki yaamo.

content: Engyu korem kuu awandi ye awad Godbed ben nongkobekore, bobni yaa burudande bindaneene yumbon kandaniibdan yaa awandime ande yedmoon dee? Anamaa.
